name: Blessings of the Great Windborne Cat Spirit

angles.text: For a druid, this rite marks a milestone in mastering feline predatory instinct. It grants the stealth, speed, and ferocity needed to commune with and assume the aspect of the cat.
As a Skyborne, the Great Cat Spirit recognizes you as young shen'dorei. Its guidance from Zephras teaches you to harness feral power through wind and shadow.

faq.answer: An initiate who has received the Great Cat Spirit's blessing returns to Dendrite to continue their spiritual communion.
faq.q: What is Blessings of the Great Windborne Cat Spirit?

faq.answer: Dendrite mentors initiates and sends them to commune with the Great Cat Spirit. When they return, his ritual gestures let him sense whether they have absorbed the stealth, speed, and cunning needed to channel feline nature.
The Great Cat Spirit is an ancient patron in Zephras. It grants worthy initiates spiritual favor, the speed of the winds, and predatory stealth before they return to their instruction.
faq.q: Who is the Great Cat Spirit?

faq.answer: Zephras is the Great Cat Spirit's home. Promising initiates travel there to seek its counsel, receive its blessings of wind and shadow, and learn the foundations of the feline form.
The Great Cat Spirit addresses the initiate as young shen'dorei, recognizing the practitioner's ancestral heritage as they seek communion with nature spirits and mastery of feral shapeshifting.
faq.q: Why does the spirit address the initiate as shen'dorei?

faq.answer: The blessing grants the cunning, speed, and stealth of the feline form. It also earns the initiate Dendrite's recognition, so they can focus their inner ferocity and call upon the true nature of the cat.
faq.q: What does the blessing of the cat spirit grant?

keywords: blessings of the great windborne cat spirit

sections.body: An initiate returns to Dendrite after seeking the Great Cat Spirit of Zephras and earning its favor. The communion has awakened the wild cat's cunning, predatory stealth, and ferocity within them.
sections.title: Communion with the Windborne Spirit

sections.body: Dendrite reads the initiate's newly awakened aura with subtle gestures. Sensing feline instincts woven into their spirit, he sees that the initiate is ready to focus their mind and call upon the true aspect of the cat.
sections.title: Dendrite's Instruction

summary: After meeting the Great Cat Spirit of Zephras, an initiate returns to Dendrite with a newly awakened aura. The blessing brings the wild cat's stealth, speed, and ferocity, and Dendrite prepares the initiate for further instruction.
attribution: In-game quest text: Blessings of the Great Windborne Cat Spirit
